# Review CHANGES REQUESTED for PAN-4523

# Review — PAN-4523
## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — the widened shelf spread (0.5 → 0.7 × width) pushes the last shelf orb off the band and half off the canvas at the default 1280 px viewport; the PR's own screenshot shows it clipped

## Context
- Run ID: agent-pan-4523-review-b579e397
- Manifest: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-4523/.pan/review/agent-pan-4523-review-b579e397/context.json
- Branch / workspace: feature/pan-4523 / /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-4523
- PR: https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/4539
- HEAD reviewed: b579e39709bfb21222adc9eae733663421dec00c
- Base / prior cycle SHA: merge-base 66777e339e4 (origin/main); no prior review cycle

## Blocking Findings

### [correctness/requirements] Last shelf orb renders past the band edge and is clipped by the canvas at laptop widths — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/GodView/confluence/model.ts:286`
- Severity: !
- Classification / requirement scope: implementation defect that follows a spec arithmetic error (PRD D3); in_pr_scope (regression introduced by this PR).
- Trigger and changed-code connection: `positionOrb` places shelf orb `i` of `n` at `padX + 140 + (i/(n-1)) * width * 0.7` (changed from `0.5`). For any shelf with ≥ 2 orbs, the last orb is always at `166 + 0.7·W`. That is inside the band (`W - padX`) only when `W ≥ 640`, and its centred label stays on the canvas only when `W ≳ 660`. `.confluence-river-canvas` has `overflow: hidden` (`confluence.css` line 154).
  PRD D3 justifies the widening with "At width 1280 the shelf ends at x ≈ 1062, left of `portalX` (1246)". That arithmetic uses the viewport width. The river canvas is much narrower, because the hook-bus panel and the right rail take ~700 px of a 1280 px viewport.
- Expected / observed / impact: Expected: every shelf orb, label and reason inside the shelf band, which the issue states as "Keep every orb label and reason inside its own band". Observed: in the committed `docs/screenshots/pan-4523/god-view-bands.png` (1280×720, the PRD's target viewport), the river canvas is ≈ 572-577 px wide. PLAN and MERGE column centres are ~417 px apart, so colW ≈ 104. The fifth shelf orb sits at canvas x ≈ 566-570, right of the MAIN portal (`portalX` ≈ 540) and past the band rect (`W - padX` ≈ 548). Half the orb is cut off, its id reads `PAN-9`, and its reason is almost entirely off-canvas. With the old 0.5 spread, that orb was at x ≈ 453, inside the band. Impact: the shelf has no census (out of scope by design), so the id and reason are the only way to identify a shelved issue. On any laptop-class window with the sidebar open, the last shelved issue becomes unreadable. That is the same defect class this issue set out to fix. W8 step 6 asked the author to inspect this PNG for exactly this kind of problem.
- Evidence: static trace of `positionOrb` (model.ts lines 284-289) plus `.confluence-river-canvas { overflow: hidden; }`. Column-position measurement on the committed PNG. I did not run a live browser; the PR's screenshot is the runtime evidence.
- Fix: derive the shelf spread from the drawable range, not from a fixed fraction of the width. For example, `spread = max(0, (W - padX - SLOT_MARGIN - slotHalf) - (padX + 140))`, or clamp the end to `portalX - margin`. Put it in one helper that both `positionOrb` and `shelfSlotWidth` use, so the slot width and the real spacing cannot drift apart. Add a `model.test.ts` case asserting `lastShelfTx + shelfSlotWidth/2 ≤ W - padX` at realistic canvas widths (e.g. 577 and 1280). Retake the screenshot and inspect it. Spec correction: D3's "x ≈ 1062 at width 1280" should be computed against the river canvas width, not the viewport width.

## Non-blocking Findings

1. **~ [requirements] `evictionFor('shelf', 'MERGE')` returns `'merge'`** — `RiverCanvas.tsx:159`. This is a specification defect that the implementation follows. PRD W3 requires `evictionFor('shelf', 'MERGE')` to be `'merge'`, and critique round 2 flagged this as unresolved. Trigger: an operator-held merged issue (state `shelf`, stage `MERGE`) is displaced by the new 8-orb shelf cap. The removal loop then calls `startMerge`, the orb animates to the portal while still drawn as a shelf orb, and `finishMerge` posts `MERGED ✓` for an issue the operator is holding. The trigger is narrow: a merged and held issue that is also the 9th or later shelf orb. Spec correction: check state first (`shelf`/`stale` → `'drop'`), and merge only an `active` MERGE orb.
2. **~ [validation gap] The new `fit-text.test.ts` does not run on CI.** CI runs frontend tests only through the explicit allowlist `test:frontend-subset` in the root `package.json`. From this directory, that list includes only `model.test.ts` and `rail-link.test.tsx`. So AC-W2's proving test, and the new `useConfluenceData.test.ts` and `choreography.test.ts` cases that prove AC-W3/W4/W5, never run in CI. The absence of the two older files is pre-existing; leaving out the new `fit-text.test.ts` is this PR's choice. Add at least `fit-text.test.ts` and `useConfluenceData.test.ts` to the subset. The Playwright spec is also missing from `test:playwright`, which runs only `command-deck-resource-strip.spec.ts`. That matches the existing pattern for `pan-NNNN` specs.
3. **~ [requirements] AC-W8 says "the PR body links it"; it does not.** The PR body has only a checklist line ("…commit its screenshot") and no link to `docs/screenshots/pan-4523/god-view-bands.png`.
4. **~ [UX] The bottom HUD tag and hint overlap at this canvas width.** In the committed screenshot, `.confluence-tag` wraps to two lines ("yielded" spills onto a second line), and the `.confluence-hint` pill is drawn over the tag text. The overlap between the two DOM overlays at narrow canvas widths is pre-existing. This PR makes the tag 9 characters longer, which causes the wrap. This is HUD text, not band text, so it is advisory. The issue's AC-6 asks for a screenshot with "no overprinted text", and this screenshot still shows overprinted HUD text.
5. **~ [performance] `fitText` measures once per removed character** (`model.ts` `fitText` while-loop). A 58-character reason fitted to a ~45 px slot with 8 shelf orbs at 1280 costs ~50 `measureText` calls, so roughly 400-500 calls per frame once stale labels are included. All of them run on every animation frame. The loop is bounded and small, so this is not material without a measurement. A binary search or a `(text, slot, font)` memo would remove the cost.
6. **? [spec concern] D7 residue on merged issues.** After a merge, `merge-agent.ts` closes the panes, so every agent is stopped and `pauseVoters` returns all agents. Any long-dead specialist row with a non-close-out `pausedReason` (PAN-3841-style residue), or a reason containing "yield", pins the merged issue to the shelf until close-out. D7 chose this explicitly ("any non-close-out pause wins"). To show impact, we would need evidence that stale paused specialist rows exist on merged issues in practice.
7. **? [correctness] Canvas-local state changes bypass the band caps.** The frost sink (active → stale) and the governor tide (active → shelf) change `orb.state` inside `advance()`. So the canvas can briefly draw a 15th stale orb or a 9th shelf orb until the next reconcile overwrites the state from props. The stale path is pre-existing; the shelf cap is new. Critique round 2 left this unresolved. It is transient.
8. **? [UX] Animated labels can overlap briefly.** A newly spawned shelf orb starts at `tx - 60`, and stale orbs wobble ±8 px. During easing, two fitted labels can overlap until the orbs settle. Critique round 2 left this unresolved. It is cosmetic and transient.
9. **? [scope] `needs-you` orbs share the shelf row but are not counted by `SHELF_ORB_LIMIT`.** The row can therefore hold more than 8 orbs. Slot widths still adapt, because `drawOrbs` counts `shelf` plus `needs-you`. FR-4 caps only the `shelf` state, so this is compliant.

### Dimensions
- **Correctness:** Band geometry is consistent, with one layout function. Stale label row selection (`orb.ty < doldrumsY`) matches the upper/lower centres (+44 / +62 vs +48). The merged-orb branch returns `active` before the stale branch can catch the orb. `spawnOrb` sets `mergeDwell` for MERGE orbs, and `advance()` checks the dwell before frost accrual, so the merge exit starts (1.5-3.5 s) before the 6 s frost sink (D10 holds). `retiredIds` prevents a respawn after `finishMerge`. `CLOSE_OUT_PAUSE_REASON` exactly matches `merge-agent.ts` line 349, and `pausedReason` reaches the snapshot through `agent-state-read.ts`. Blocker: the shelf spread (above).
- **Security:** No new trust boundary. `pausedReason` is only compared and drawn with canvas `fillText`, with no HTML sink. No dependencies changed.
- **Performance:** Bounded per-frame `filter`/`measureText` work. See advisory 5.
- **Requirements/UX:** See the AC matrix below.

## Verification
- `gh pr checks 4539` at head b579e397: every job passes, including build (22), lint, lint-group core/effect/skills/state (effect diagnostics covered by lint-group effect), test-shard 1-4, test-e2e, test, and `overdeck/test` (verification gate: typecheck plus lint). Mintlify was skipped.
- Local focused run: `npx vitest run` on `model.test.ts`, `fit-text.test.ts`, `useConfluenceData.test.ts`, `choreography.test.ts`, `confluence-smoke.test.tsx` → 5 files, 65 tests passed. Only `model.test.ts` of these also runs on CI.
- Not run: the Playwright spec (it needs `npm run build` plus an isolated dashboard). I used the committed screenshot as the runtime evidence. I did not run the full suite, per the review budget.

## Scope Note
PRD "Unresolved after two critic rounds" lists three items: the held MERGE orb merge exit, canvas transitions bypassing the caps, and animated text slots. All three shipped as specified. Advisory 1 is the cheapest to fix while the author is already cycling on the blocker.
